AstraLabs GmbH — Data Breach Notification Procedure (v2.1)

1. Purpose
This procedure implements GDPR Article 33 (72-hour notification to the supervisory authority)
and supports NIS2 Article 23 early warning where applicable.

2. Scope
All personal data breaches affecting EU/EEA data subjects processed by AstraLabs entities.

3. Roles
- Incident Commander: CISO
- DPO: coordinates supervisory authority communication
- Legal: reviews notification content

4. Timelines
- Internal escalation: within 1 hour of confirmed breach
- Supervisory authority notification: within 72 hours (GDPR Art.33)
- Data subject notification: without undue delay when high risk

5. Testing
Tabletop exercise scheduled Q2 2026. Last full test: not yet completed (gap tracked as finding-001).

6. Evidence
Maintain incident log, notification templates, and authority contact list in the compliance vault.
